heroHeadline: TTP Ambush Kills 10 Police in Kohat as Border Clashes Persist
heroSubtitle: A TTP ambush in Kohat on November 11 killed 10 Pakistani police and, per police, 18 militants. Pakistan–Taliban border clashes continued into early November at Torkham, Angoor Adda and Kurram. Each side blames the other and casualty claims are unverified.
